paragraphs.text: Riko was a student of Minamo on Kamigawa , a mage and an excellent archer .

Contrary to the striking feminine features of Michiko , Riko was rather boyish, with a muscular bow-arm and short hair. Toshi Umezawa even considered her an assassin or a bodyguard in disguise. She faithfully accompanied Michiko through the whole endeavor that led to the end of the Kami War .
